probe.description: Capture each selected FP32 provider output and its immediately following BF16 materialization at the same physical-plan boundary, then compare the materialization re-expanded to FP32 with independent RN-even FP32-to-BF16 conversion.

conclusion: The selected physical FP32-to-BF16 materialization and buffer binding are exact at representative early, GDN, and final layers. They are not the source of the deterministic long-context numerical drift. Continue localization at arithmetic/state boundaries.
